newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NationsBank buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NationsBank buy repeated.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst George Salem reitereated a buy rating on NationsBank Corp and raised the 12-month target to $105/shr from $95

-- Analyst said NationsBank outlook remains bright despite temporary dilution of six percent on reported 1997 earnings due to pending acquisition of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc. Says NationsBank drop Friday "overdone."
-- Analyst says deal is accretive from the beginning on cash earnings per share as opposed to reported earnings
